title: Code cleanup and consistency pass
summary: Shared analytics DTOs, centralized toast notifications, reactive CRUD pages, and a consistent layout across all views.
changes: Extracted shared analytics DTO records into a dedicated Models/AnalyticsDtos.cs file, removing duplicate inline definitions from Dashboard and Analytics pages.
Moved the Toast component into MainLayout so notifications work globally from a single instance.
Workers, Services, and Products pages now subscribe to store changes and auto-refresh when data is imported or reset.
The Record Service page now uses the same workspace-hero layout as all other pages.
Fixed the mobile sidebar toggle so it actually slides the nav in and out.
Removed an unused IJSRuntime inject from ConfirmDialog.
